notes.title: Steam Trading Cards now available!
notes.content: Steam Trading Cards are now available for The Artifact. The set features 5 badges and 1 foil, 6 trading cards, 3 backgrounds, and 5 emoticons. We hope you enjoy them. Thanks for your support.
